scope: Development calibration only. Existing inspected annotations are never an untouched test. No production gate change or automatic acceptance.
grouping: Connected components over normalized query, normalized source path and exact normalized raw passage text. Any component containing a historically fitted pair is excluded from independent calibration of v1/v2.

selection.tie_break: max recall, min false positives, highest threshold

uncertainty: With zero false positives among n independent negatives, 1-0.05^(1/n) is a one-sided95% upper bound. Authored correlated examples do NOT satisfy independence; show it only as a sample-size diagnostic, never a deployment guarantee.
locked_test: A separately frozen, unseen query/source group set must remain excluded from calibration selection. Existing examples have all been inspected; untouched_test_count=0.
provenance: All current labels are provisional Codex coverage judgments. Factual accuracy and independent human acceptance remain separate.
